subject: Taxes
title: AI and the Future of Tax
description: Learn AI and the Future of Tax in one minute.

hook.text: If robots replace workers, who pays the payroll taxes? Bill Gates suggested a 'robot tax' to fund displaced workers.

buildup.text: Tax systems depend on human labor. Income tax, payroll tax, and Social Security all assume people earn wages.

discovery.text: South Korea reduced tax incentives for automation in 2017—the world's first policy acknowledging robots as a tax issue.

twist.text: Critics argue a robot tax would slow innovation. The cure might be worse than the disease.

climax.text: AI forces a rethinking of what gets taxed. If labor shrinks, governments must find new revenue sources—or shrink too.

punchline.text: Robots don't pay taxes. That's a problem if they take the jobs.

quiz.question: Which country first addressed robots as a tax policy issue?
